headline: Ransomware Attack Grinds Operations to a Halt at Hitachi Astemo's Dongguan Facility
body: In a significant cyber breach, Hitachi Astemo Automotive Powertrain Technologies (Dongguan) Ltd. has been forced to shut down production at its Dongguan site. The plant, formerly known as Dongguan Keihin Engine Management System Co., Ltd., was hit by ransomware that locked key manufacturing and logistics systems. While the company collaborates with cybersecurity experts for recovery, it remains unclear when full operations will resume. Meanwhile, NGK Ceramics Suzhou Co., Ltd. is also dealing with related disruptions in its processes.
